name: Lab 12 - Layer 2 Security (Snooping, BPDU Guard, Port-Securi

notes.text: Lab 12 - Layer 2 Security (built on Lab 11). Base works: all PCs get DHCP from R1 via DSW1 relay. Threats on SW1 VLAN10: F0/12 ROGUE-SW (STP pri 0) | F0/13 DESK-SW with PC3+PC4. T1 STP: show spanning-tree vlan 10 on SW1 -> root port Fa0/12 = rogue is root! Fix: spanning-tree bpduguard enable on F0/12 (or root guard). Twist: bpduguard default also err-disables F0/13 - why? T2 Port-security F0/13: max 1, sticky, violation shutdown -> 2nd MAC err-disables port. Recover: shut / no shut. T3 DHCP snooping: ip dhcp snooping + vlan 10,20 -> PCs renew and FAIL: no trusted uplink! Fix: ip dhcp snooping trust on Po1 (+ no ip dhcp snooping information option if DSW1 drops option 82). Verify: show ip dhcp snooping binding | show port-security | show spanning-tree vlan 10.

T1 STP: show spanning-tree vlan 10 on SW1 -> root port Fa0/12 = rogue is root! Fix: spanning-tree bpduguard enable on F0/12 (or root guard). Twist: bpduguard default also err-disables F0/13 - why? T2 Port-security F0/13: max 1, sticky, violation shutdown -> 2nd MAC err-disables port. Recover: shut / no shut. T3 DHCP snooping: ip dhcp snooping + vlan 10,20 -> PCs renew and FAIL: no trusted uplink! Fix: ip dhcp snooping trust on Po1 (+ no ip dhcp snooping information option if DSW1 drops option 82). Verify: show ip dhcp snooping binding | show port-security | show spanning-tree vlan 10.
